correctness.rationale: Direct Poisson integration proves the exact Exp/Gamma5 to Geom/NB5 mixing identity. The logarithmic jump coefficients are q^n/n times 5 minus a conjugate-root sum. The two near roots have modulus at least 1 exactly when δ≥sqrt(2), yielding positive summable coefficients; otherwise their modulus is strictly less than 1, and argument recurrence yields infinitely many negative coefficients. The exact PXR algebra and strictly monotone rate polynomial prove the unique cutoff including equality. SymPy exact arithmetic independently checks normalization, generating-function identity, two rational-rate samples, and a negative coefficient beyond the cutoff.

value.rationale: The result classifies a natural common-probability convex mixture of two infinitely divisible count laws by a sharp parameter boundary and resolves the ordinary compound-Poisson process interpretation for the entire Poisson–XRani model. Its negative side has infinitely many explicit coefficient obstructions, even though mixed-Poisson overdispersion remains everywhere. This is a structural full-phase theorem with a motivated statistical modeling consequence, not a routine moment calculation or isolated parameter substitution.
